b1-13-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Official Source
b1-13-01.scenario: You are Carlos. In Budapest, Meg asks what the news says about a strange incident. According to the official source, it happened during the night.
b1-13-01.prompt: Tell Meg what the official source says about when the incident happened.
b1-13-01.target: Según la fuente oficial, el suceso ocurrió durante la noche.
b1-13-01.english: According to the official source, the incident happened during the night.
b1-13-01.canDo: I can report information and identify its source.

b1-13-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Witness Said
b1-13-02.scenario: You are Meg. In Budapest, Carlos asks what the witness said on the news. She said that she had seen a light from her window.
b1-13-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what the witness said.
cues: Say where she had seen it
b1-13-02.target: La testigo dijo que había visto una luz desde su ventana.
b1-13-02.english: The witness said that she had seen a light from her window.
b1-13-02.canDo: I can report what another person said.

b1-13-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Is It Reliable?
b1-13-03.scenario: You are Carlos. In Budapest, Meg asks whether you trust a news source. You doubt that it is completely reliable, but it may have more information.
b1-13-03.prompt: Tell Meg what you think about the source.
cues: Say you doubt the source is reliable
Say it is possible it has more information
b1-13-03.target: No creo que la fuente sea fiable, pero es posible que tenga más información.
b1-13-03.english: I do not think the source is reliable, but it is possible that it has more information.
b1-13-03.canDo: I can separate facts from opinions and doubt.

b1-13-04.title: Communicative Challenge: How the Story Developed
b1-13-04.scenario: You are Meg. In Budapest, Carlos asks how the news story developed. First the information from witnesses arrived, later a recording appeared, and finally the investigators explained what had happened.
b1-13-04.prompt: Tell Carlos the three stages of the story in order.
b1-13-04.target: Primero llegó la información de los testigos, posteriormente apareció una grabación y finalmente los investigadores explicaron qué había sucedido.
b1-13-04.english: First the information from the witnesses arrived, later a recording appeared, and finally the investigators explained what had happened.
b1-13-04.canDo: I can follow and explain the development of a news story.

b1-13-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Statue in the Bay
b1-13-05.scenario: You are Carlos. In Budapest, Meg asks about the chronicle on the Statue of Liberty that you read in Spanish. Thousands of people met in the bay, and many immigrants cried.
cues: Say what thousands of people did
Say how many immigrants reacted and why
b1-13-05.target: Miles de personas se reunieron en la bahía para ver la estatua, y muchos inmigrantes lloraron porque para ellos representaba un comienzo nuevo.
b1-13-05.english: Thousands of people met in the bay to see the statue, and many immigrants cried because for them it represented a new beginning.
b1-13-05.canDo: I can summarise a news report clearly.

b1-13-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Witnesses and Doubt
b1-13-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. In Budapest, Carlos asks what the news said about the strange light and what you think. According to the witnesses a light appeared, but you do not think the information is reliable yet.
b1-13-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what the witnesses said and what you think.
cues: Say what you think about the information
b1-13-consolidation.target: Según los testigos, apareció una luz, pero no creo que la información sea fiable todavía.
b1-13-consolidation.english: According to the witnesses, a light appeared, but I do not think the information is reliable yet.
b1-13-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate media and information vocabulary.
